input.quote: any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement (each, a "Dispute") shall be exclusively resolved by final and binding arbitration as follows:
input.rationale: Section 18.3 already selects New York law, so the governing-law element is met verbatim. The forum, however, fails both the preferred and the fallback checklists: Section 17.3 sends all non-Expert disputes to exclusive, binding three-arbitrator ICC arbitration, with the seat in Osaka, Japan whenever Array demands it (New York only when Ono demands). That is mandatory arbitration capable of being seated outside the accepted list rather than the accepted-jurisdiction courts, i.e. walk-away territory on the forum limb. The redline keeps the New York law selection untouched and converts the referral and the ICC/seat provision into exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, retaining the ability to seek temporary injunctive relief in any other court (as Section 17.3(g) contemplated) and switching off the residual arbitral procedure subsections so nothing dangles.

ops.oldText: shall be exclusively resolved by final and binding arbitration as follows:
ops.newText: shall be resolved exclusively as follows:

ops.oldText: (a) Arbitration under the ICC Rules of Arbitration. The arbitration shall be conducted by three (3) arbitrators according to the ICC Rules of Arbitration ("Rules"), and the panel of three arbitrators so selected is referred to herein as the "Arbitration Tribunal." The seat of the arbitration shall be in Osaka, Japan, if it is demanded by Array, and in New York, NY, USA, if it is demanded by Ono, with hearings to held in the same location. The Emergency Arbitrator Provisions shall not apply.
ops.newText: (a) Exclusive Jurisdiction. The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York shall have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits of any Dispute, provided that either Party may apply to any other court of competent jurisdiction for temporary injunctive relief. Sections 17.3(b) through (g) shall not apply.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] New York law already governs, but the merits forum is three-arbitrator ICC arbitration that is seated in Osaka whenever Array demands it, which falls outside our accepted position of accepted-jurisdiction courts rather than foreign arbitration. We have replaced the arbitration referral and the ICC/seat provision with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, preserving each Party's ability to seek temporary injunctive relief in any other court and switching off the residual arbitral procedures.
proposal.summary: Convert mandatory ICC arbitration (seat Osaka or New York) into exclusive jurisdiction of the New York County state and federal courts, with temporary injunctive relief available elsewhere.
